name: Head-Eyes Like Experience (SAIN Preset)
teaser: "I got Lvl 6 plates. I am invincible!" - not on my watch, champ.
description_html:
This is a continuation of Shibdib’s Live Like Experience 1.2.0 which enables aiming for head for all the bots.

tl;dr PMC’s and Bosses will try to headshot you at least once per standard mag on average.

PMC’s: 1.25 - 5% chance (higher bot difficulty = bigger chance); SCAV’s: 0.5 - 1.1% chance; Bosses: 3% and their followers: 2%; Rogues and Raiders: 1.3 - 3.5% chance; Goons: 2 - 8% chance for BigPipe, 3 - 9% for Birdeye, 4 - 10% for Knight; Cultists: 1.1 - 1.4% chance and their Priest: 1.15-1.6% chance;

Bot hearing has also been buffed per group, with PMC’s hearing up to 40% better than baseline (at impossible difficulty). SCAV hear 40 up to 10% worse than baseline (depends on bot difficulty). Bosses always hear 10% better than baseline, and their followers hear 20% worse. Goons hear 20% better than baseline.

Global bot hearing has been increased by 30% (compared to Live Like Experience). Global aggression, bot accuracy and precision have been increased by 5%.

Original preset by Shibdib: https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/1933/live-like-experience-sain-preset
